name: VLA-REPLICA
summary: 低成本 SO-101 机器人视觉语言动作复现实验数据集，包含示范、动作状态和场景参考。
summaryEn: A low-cost SO-101 vision-language-action replication dataset with demonstrations, action-state streams, and reference scenes.
scaleZh: 10 个任务、500 条示范和 90 个场景参考
organizationsZh: 德州大学达拉斯分校 IRVL
licenseZh: 见 Hugging Face 数据条款
access: SFT data available on Hugging Face with official code
accessZh: SFT 数据已在 Hugging Face 提供，并有官方代码
verdict: 可复现实机动作条件策略和场景泛化的机器人数据
verdictEn: Robot data for reproducible action-conditioned policies and scene generalization
wmNote: 示范中的动作、状态和语言条件可用于具身世界模型训练。
wmNoteEn: Action, state, and language conditions in demonstrations support embodied world-model training.
